verdict.rationale: The only first-party background automation in the evidence is merchant-account sweeping, which users configure in Console (truelayer-docs-20). Mandates that let payments execute without further user authorisation (truelayer-docs-16, truelayer-docs-31) and webhooks are developer building blocks: the developer must still schedule and trigger each payment. No general-purpose automation, scheduling or workflow capability is documented. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation/scheduling feature, documentation of how sweeping runs and is controlled, recurring payments that run without developer-side triggering, and independent corroboration.
